login.title: Log in
login.intro: Prepare for the German nursing language exam (Fachsprachprüfung Pflege) alongside your GWS German course.

errors.invalid: Email address or password is incorrect.
errors.no_access: This account does not have access to the training app. Please contact GWS.
errors.link: The link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account with this address exists, we have sent you an email.
forgot.invalid: Please enter a valid email address.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.intro: Choose a password with at least 8 characters.

errors.tooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please open the link from the email again.

learn.title: Your training for the language exam
learn.intro: Practise nursing vocabulary, conversations and documentation from everyday care – in short lessons for reading, listening, writing and speaking.

lesson.askQuestion: Ask GWS a question about this lesson
lesson.question: Question {n}
lesson.resultPractice: Practice makes perfect – repeat this lesson again later.
lesson.submittedInfo: Thank you! GWS has received your submission. You will get feedback.
lesson.showList: Show all terms as a list
lesson.listenIntro: Listen to the text, then answer the questions. You can play it several times.
lesson.noSpeech: Your browser cannot read the text aloud. Please use Chrome, Edge or Safari.
lesson.recordIntro: Read the task, record your answer (up to {max}) and listen to it before you submit.
lesson.micError: No access to the microphone. Please allow access in your browser.
lesson.noFeedback: No feedback yet – GWS will get back to you soon.

messages.title: Messages to GWS
messages.intro: Ask questions about lessons, the exam or your course. The GWS team will answer you here.
messages.error: The message could not be sent.

profile.title: My profile
profile.emailHint: If you change your address, we will send a confirmation link to the new address.
profile.emailPending: Saved. Please confirm your new email address using the link in your inbox.

errors.invalid: Please fill in all fields correctly.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.email: The email address could not be changed.
errors.tooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.

invite.title: Invite a customer
invite.intro: The person receives an email with a link to set their password.

errors.invalid: Please fill in all fields correctly.
errors.generic: The invitation could not be created.
errors.noKey: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY is missing from the environment variables. Invitations are not possible without it.

results.noMail: Access created. Email sending is not set up – please send this link to the person yourself.
results.mailFailed: Access created, but the email could not be sent. Please send this link to the person yourself.

inbox.title: Messages
inbox.intro: All conversations with customers. Open messages are shown first.

feedback.title: Submissions
feedback.intro: Customers' writing and speaking exercises waiting for feedback.
feedback.label: Feedback
feedback.placeholder: What is good, what should be improved?
feedback.saved: Saved, the customer will be notified.

content.title: Learning content
content.intro: Create and edit modules and lessons. Customers only see published content.
content.error: That did not work. Please check your input.
content.noLessons: No lessons in this module yet.
content.confirmDeleteModule: Permanently delete this module with all lessons and results?

editor.previewNote: Preview: this is how customers see the lesson. Results are not saved.
editor.material: Material for the task (optional, e.g. patient data)
editor.transcriptHint: Read aloud if no audio file is uploaded, and shown after answering.
editor.audioHint: MP3, M4A, OGG, WAV or WebM, up to 20 MB.
editor.speaker: Speaker
editor.correctHint: Select the dot next to the correct answer.
editor.alternatives: Other correct solutions, separated by commas
editor.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this lesson with all results?

mail.inviteSubject: Your invitation to the GWS language training app
mail.inviteBody:
Hello {name},

GWS talent transfer has invited you to the training app for the German nursing language exam (Fachsprachprüfung Pflege).

Set your password here:
{link}

The link is valid for 24 hours.

Best regards
Your GWS team
mail.resetSubject: New password for the GWS language training app
mail.resetBody:
Hello {name},

use this link to set a new password:
{link}

If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

Best regards
Your GWS team
mail.replyBody:
Hello {name},

the GWS team has replied to you in the language training app:
{link}

Best regards
Your GWS team
mail.feedbackBody:
Hello {name},

GWS has given you feedback on your writing or speaking exercise:
{link}

Best regards
Your GWS team
